title: Adaptive Deadline Design with Unknown Endpoint-Specific Exponential Reporting Rates
banked_reason: Post-repair D0.5 math and rubric PASS with all eight sources attested; achieved subfield below field floor, paper_score_ceiling 6.6 < 7.4, not salvageable within scope. Independent validity consult confirms bounded repairs then downgraded bank.
gap_reasons: The sharp all-controller result concerns regular squared risk; critical and finite-exposure decision values concern the concentrating design, while sharp all-controller connected-interval length remains unresolved.
Certified LP approximability is proved, but computed critical decision curves and substantive finite-sample comparisons of allocation, risk and coverage are absent.
These restrictions on breadth and demonstrated usability constrain the projected leading-econometrics score to 6.6.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived matching all-adaptive finite-budget risk and honest-length orders, concentrating-design critical/finite-exposure decision limits, and the sharp regular squared-risk constant 24(r+3) with static optimality. A local Fourier-variable typo and positioning omissions were repaired; the final math and rubric panels pass, with all eight cited leaves verified by attestation. Field novelty was not achieved (subfield, score ceiling 6.6 < 7.4); sharp all-controller interval constants and adaptive critical/finite-exposure allocation remain open, and no Lean formalization was launched.
tldr: Unknown endpoint-specific exponential reporting rates reduce the prevalence information in short records to cubic deadline order. The declared observation-budget experiment has matching all-adaptive finite-budget risk and honest-length orders, explicit original-record attainers, and proved critical and finite-exposure decision transfers, including moving or collapsing fibers. In the regular regime \(b\to0\), \(Hb^2\to\infty\), and \(H/(Nb)\to r\), the sharp all-adaptive squared-risk value is \(24(r+3)/(Hb^2)\): a static balanced two-deadline design with budget-feasible rounding and exact likelihood correction attains it. Feedback cannot improve this minimax risk constant. The sharp connected-interval constant remains unresolved; honest intervals of the matching order are available at every finite budget. The exact reporting clock and additive deadline cost are declared prospective working-model restrictions requiring local calibration.
gap: Informative reporting estimation at fixed positive analysis time and regular delayed response-adaptive efficiency are established. Their proofs do not characterize a chosen shrinking-deadline budget when prevalence and four unknown reporting hazards have different information scales.
fill: An original-transcript all-controller finite-budget risk and honest-length frontier, a feasible concentrating benchmark, a certified leading deadline optimization, and a critical experiment whose nuisance-preserving decision transfer is exposed as open mathematical work. The frontier describes the declared mark-specific exponential and additive deadline-cost model; prospective use requires local calibration and sensitivity analysis of both restrictions.
